speaker: Lenneth
original_jp: 私自身の世界を救うために別の未来から来たの
original_en:
I have come from an alternate future to
save my own world.

speaker: Lenneth
original_jp: 彼は私の時代 <PART> ―― <PART> 未来から来た異端の存在なの
original_en:
He is a heretic. A man who has come from
my time <PART> ---- <PART> the future.

speaker: Lenneth
original_jp: おかげで私の世界は壊れ始めている
original_en: And thus my world has begun to crumble.

speaker: Lenneth
original_jp: …あなたに助けられるはずだった〓因は間違いなくレザードにあるわ
original_en:
You were supposed to have saved her.
But Lezard, of course, got in the way.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: やはりお前か レナス…
original_en: I knew it was you, Lenneth.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: ディパンでもお前の波動を感じたが…フレイに呼ばれて来たのか？
original_en:
I could sense you back in Dipan.
Did Freya call you here?

speaker: Lenneth
original_jp: ラグナロクの後…オーディンがいない世界だ
original_en:
The world after Ragnarok, where Odin is
no more.

speaker: Lenneth
original_jp: 私でなく レザードが…

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: ディパンの城にあった時間〓御〓置と何か関係があるのか？
original_en:
So, I take it we owe this visit to the
time machine in Dipan Castle?

speaker: Lenneth
original_jp: 私はヴァルキリーではない創造神レナス <PART> ――
original_en:
I am not the valkyrie you know. I am
Lenneth the creator.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: …人間が近づけぬよう封〓したつもりでいたが やはり破壊しておくべきだったか
original_en:
I sealed off the machine to keep humans
away, but I should have destroyed it.
